subject: Sandboxed node exception — residency & ops access for Sentinel Health
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <procurement@sentinelhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 18 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Sandboxed node — initial ask and proposed guardrails

Alex — thanks again for the call earlier. Per your team's checklist, Sentinel would like a short, timeboxed sandboxed node deployment inside customer-managed VPC for the pilot. Key asks summarized below so Deal Desk / Legal can evaluate: 

- Data residency: model inference logs and ephemeral KV cache to remain in Sentinel VPC; telemetry (health/status) only via aggregated metrics to Redwood hosted console.
- Audit & forensics: 90-day forensics window with read-only snapshot export on customer request (up to 3 requests per year).
- Ops access: read-only runbooks + jumpbox access for emergency troubleshooting limited to named engineers, with IP allowlist and session recording.
- KMS: integration to Sentinel KMS (customer-managed keys) for storage of audit/export artifacts.
- Duration & SLOs: 3-month pilot; Redwood to maintain 99.5% service availability on the node; degraded-mode fallback to hosted model with notification.
- Commercial: requesting a 15% one-year pilot discount and a capped support fee for on-site/ops work.

Attached is Sentinel's appendix and our draft MA (redwood-ma-draft-v3.pdf). We believe the risk can be mitigated with the guardrails above and a scoped SOW. Can Deal Desk / Leadership confirm whether we can accept the residency + limited-forensics ask + 15% pilot discount, or do we need to route for Exec approval?

Thanks,
Mateo
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0147
[Attachments: Sentinel_Req_Appendix.pdf, redwood-ma-draft-v3.pdf]

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 10:14:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sandboxed node — initial ask and proposed guardrails

Mateo — thanks for the summary. A few follow-ups from Deal Desk before we elevate to Exec: 

1) Risk assessment: can you quantify expected ops hours per month for the pilot and a rough estimate of delta in token/unit cost vs hosted? We need $ impact to finance.
2) Controls checklist: please populate the ops-access-matrix.xlsx with named engineers, IP ranges, and session recording retention.
3) For the 90-day forensics window: is Sentinel requesting on-demand raw KV exports or compressed/readable artifacts? The former is a material change.
4) Legal: we will need a proposed redline highlighting the residency clause, audit triggers, and indemnity cap.

If we think mitigations are strong, Deal Desk can approve a pilot-level discount (up to 15%) conditional on signed SOW and a timeboxed indemnity carveout reviewed by Legal. If not, we'll route to Laura for Exec signoff.

Marissa
Sales Operations | Redwood Inference
[On Fri, Nov 19, 2027 at 08:12 AM Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com> wrote:]
> Alex — thanks again for the call earlier...

From: Alex Rivera <procurement@sentinelhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
Cc: Dawn Li <legal@sentinelhealth.com>, Sentinel Health - Security Team <security@sentinelhealth.com>
Date: Fri, 19 Nov 2027 13:32:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Sandboxed node — initial ask and proposed guardrails

Thanks Mateo — quick clarifications from Sentinel: 

- Forensics exports: we require raw session logs (pseudonymized) plus model input/output traces for up to 90 days for regulatory review, export format to be determined but must be machine-readable (CSV/NDJSON).
- Audit trigger: Sentinel can request an audit snapshot up to twice during the 3-month pilot and once in the following 6 months. Exports will be delivered to our KMS-encrypted bucket.
- Support SLA: Sentinel requests a 2-hour response window for Sev1 incidents during the pilot window and a named escalation contact.

We prefer to keep the pilot agile; happy to sign a limited SOW if Redwood accepts the data export format and KMS integration. Also seeking confirmation on the discounted rate and any additional support fees.

Regards,
Alex Rivera
Procurement Lead | Sentinel Health
procurement@sentinelhealth.com
[Attachment: Sentinel_Req_Appendix.pdf]

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 08:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Sandboxed node — escalation request (Sentinel Health)

Team — forwarding the back-and-forth with Sentinel. They are firm on machine-readable raw exports (pseudonymized) and an aggressive forensics/audit cadence (2 audits in pilot + 1 post-pilot). The commercial ask is 15% pilot discount + capped support fee and 2-hour Sev1 SLA during pilot.

Why I think Exec exception is reasonable: 
- Strategic account: Sentinel is a high-value regional payer prospect with potential expansion across three lines of business — expected ARR > $1.2M if pilot converts.
- Timeboxed risk: pilot limited to 3 months with strict IP/KMS controls and session recording.
- Mitigations: 1) read-only exports; 2) pseudonymization of PII; 3) maximum 2 audit requests during the pilot; 4) indemnity carveout limited to breaches tied to Redwood negligence only.

Requested approvals: 
1) Exec signoff to accept machine-readable raw export (pseudonymized) limited to 90 days and capped to 3 exports (2 during pilot + 1 post-pilot).
2) One-year pilot discount of 15% and a fixed pilot support fee not to exceed $12,000.

If Laura OKs, Legal should redline MA and Finance to confirm pricing impact. Otherwise we risk losing the opportunity.

— Mateo
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[Quoted: Alex Rivera <procurement@sentinelhealth.com>]

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>, Legal <legal@redwood.com>, Finance <finance@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 16:07:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Sandboxed node — escalation request (Sentinel Health)

Thanks — good summary. Conditional Exec approval provided on the following conditions: 

1) Legal must produce a redline of the MA that: (a) limits Redwood's liability to negligence; (b) requires pseudonymization and documents the export format and delivery process; (c) includes a strict 3-export cap (2 pilot, 1 post-pilot) and mutually agreed trigger definition for audits.
2) Finance to confirm the 15% pilot discount + fixed support fee up to $12,000 fits within our ACV and regional quotas; if not, reduce discount to 10% and rerun economics.
3) Security to validate the ops access matrix and approve named engineering accounts before any access is granted.
4) All approvals must be documented in HubSpot and SOW signed before any work begins.

Marissa — please coordinate Legal/Finance/Security workstreams and update me in HubSpot by EOD Wednesday. If Legal flags material exposure we will step back.

Laura Bennett
VP, Sales | Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com
[Action items: Legal redline, Finance pricing sign-off, Security ops-matrix review]
